items.correct: Unlimited wants exceed limited resources, forcing choices.
items.random_wrong: That a country has no money.
items.why: Scarcity is the core economic problem: finite resources, infinite wants.

items.correct: The next best alternative given up when you make a choice.
items.misconception: Only the money price of an item.
items.random_wrong: Zero, if the item was free.
items.why: Every choice sacrifices the best alternative; even 'free' options cost time or resources.
